groups.label: Question Formation & Negation System
groups.definition: Forming Yes/No questions, Wh- questions, imperatives, and negative sentences using auxiliary verbs.
rules: Yes/No Questions: Auxiliary / Modal + Subject + Main Verb? (Do you speak English?)
Wh- Questions: Question Word + Auxiliary + Subject + Main Verb? (Where do you live?)
Negation: Subject + Auxiliary + NOT + Main Verb (I don't know / She isn't here).
Imperatives: Base verb for positive; Don't + base verb for negative (Open the door! / Don't touch that!).

groups.label: Cleft Sentences & Inversion for Emphasis
groups.definition: Syntactic re-packaging techniques (It-clefts, Wh-clefts, Inversion) to place focus or dramatic emphasis on specific elements.
rules: It-Cleft: It is/was + [Focused Element] + that/who... (It was Sarah who solved the issue).
Wh-Cleft: What I + [Verb] + is/was... (What we need is clear communication).
Inversion after negative adverbs: Never / Rarely / Seldom + Auxiliary + Subject + Verb (Rarely have I seen such dedication).

examples.t: It was the CEO who approved the budget.
Seldom do we encounter such resistance.
